plugin.name: emeraldwf
plugin._long: Brings Emerald themes and engines to Wayfire. Edit themes in the Emerald Theme Manager app.

option.name: engine
option._long: Overrides the engine used to render window frames. The default uses the engine defined in the active theme. If the override differs from the theme's engine, that engine is rendered with the default emerald theme, since theme assets are engine-specific.

option.name: theme_dir
option._long: Path to the emerald theme directory (theme.ini + PNGs). Defaults to ~/.emerald/theme. Core settings live in ~/.emerald/settings.ini.

option.name: maximized_borders
option._long: Whether or not to render side and bottom decorations on maximized (tiled) windows. When true, the emerald look is preserved (shadow inside the extents).

option.name: maximized_shadows
option._long: Whether or not to allocate space for shadows on maximized (tiled) windows.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Decoration disabled for specified window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria (view matcher).

option.name: always_decorate
option._short: Decoration applied for specified window types
option._long: Forces window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria (view matcher). Use this to decorate CSD (self-decorating) windows with a double chrome.

option.name: use_decoration_cropping
option._long: Maximized windows keep only the titlebar strip: the side and bottom decorations are cropped away. Takes precedence over the maximized border and shadow options while enabled.

option.name: double_click_action
option._long: Action performed on a double-click of the titlebar.

option.name: middle_click_action
option._long: Action performed on a middle-click of the titlebar.

option.name: enable_shade
option._long: Enables emerald's scroll-to-shade (and the shade/unshade button). Scroll on a titlebar, hold the shade modifier and scroll, or use the IPC binding to fold a window into its titlebar.

option.name: shade_modifier
option._long: When the shade modifier key is held down, you can scroll up and down to shade and unshade the window under the cursor.

option.name: shade_toggle
option._long: Toggles shade for the active window (bindable via wcm).

option.name: shade_duration
option._long: The duration of the shade animation.

option.name: csd_titlebar_height
option._long: Because there is no way to know the client surface titlebar height for CSD windows, this is an option to adjust the shade strip height for them.

option.name: shadow_pad
option._long: Non-zero shadow thickness exported for CSD (self-decorating) windows via the wf-decoration-shadow-margin custom data, so a standalone shadow plugin can shadow them. 0 = no pad.

option.name: no_scroll_shade
option._long: Prevents scrolling over the titlebar from shading or unshading the window.

option.name: use_button_fade
option._long: Fades the titlebar button highlight in and out over the fade duration, instead of switching it instantly on hover.

option.name: use_button_fade_pulse
option._long: While a titlebar button is hovered, its highlight keeps breathing between full opacity and the pulse minimum opacity.

option.name: button_fade_total_duration
option._long: How long the button highlight takes to fade in or out, in milliseconds.

option.name: button_fade_step_duration
option._long: The duration of one fade step, in milliseconds. The total duration is split into steps of this size.

option.name: button_fade_pulse_wait_duration
option._long: How long the pulse holds at full highlight between breaths, in milliseconds.

option.name: button_fade_pulse_min_opacity
option._long: The lowest highlight opacity the pulse reaches, as a percentage of full opacity.
